QuestInfo.name: The Man in the Black Suit
QuestInfo.1: You met #bAgent M#k in the Omega Sector Secure Location, and found out that Korin was kidnapped by the aliens that invaded Omega Sector. You were told to eliminate #rMateon#k and bring #b5 #i4031090##t4031090##k items containing Korin's memories back. Go to #
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the aliens that stole Korin's memory and brought the Pieces of Memory back to Agent M. He combined the pieces into one, but he can't return it to Korin. It seems she won't be able to get her memory back after all...

0.0: ...I would say I don't know that person, but I can see I can't fool you. What I am about to tell you is not to leave Omega Sector. Is that clear? If so, I'll tell you about #b#p2041015##k.
0.1: I wish I could say I have no knowledge of that person, but looking at you, I don't think that's going to work. Alright, then, I'll tell you everything I know about her. Before that, though, can you please promise me that you won't tell anyone anything about matters regarding #b#p2041015##k, myself included?

yes.0: Okay, then. I'll spill out everything I know. I've actually been well aware of the fact that she'd been declared missing, but by then, it was past our hands. All we could do afterwards was to just hope for her safe return.
yes.1: She was kidnapped by the aliens that invaded Omega Sector. I'm guessing she was kidnapped by #r#o4230119##k, since she lost her memory.
yes.2: They probably tried to lock down the place by kidnapping a few residents. You can find #b#t4031090##k containing #b#p2041015##k's memories from the battle with #r#o4230119##k on Boswell Field. They might be of some use.
yes.3: Please gather up #b5 Pieces of Memory#k for me, so I can put them all together for you. Now, I trust that you keep all this information to yourself. Please head over to Boswell Field and face them. They are difficult to fight against, so I advise you to be on your toes at all times.

no.0: This is classified information, and it's a dangerous mission, to say the least, so I cannot stress this enough, but please do not reveal this information to anyone. I cannot talk to you about anything unless you promise to keep this information a secret. Well then, I'll have to get back to work, so if you'll excuse me...

1.0: Great job taking down the #b#o4230119#s#k at the Boswell Field and collecting #b5 Pieces of Memory#k in the process. Alright, then. I'll try to put these pieces together and make it a whole. Here are some Mesos as a sign of thanks for taking out some aliens for us.

yes.0: You did will, but...these memories are badly damaged. You could take this to #b#p2041015##k and regain some memories, but I can't say what effect the damage might have. It may be better to leave those memories behind...
yes.1: You could try to find another way to retrieve the memories. \nOr it might be better...to live without them.

item.0: I don't think you have collected all the pieces of #b#p2041015##k's lost memory. Please head over to the Boswell field near the Omega Sector and defeat #b#o4230119##k, in order to collect #b5 Pieces of Memory#k to recover #b#p2041015#'s#k memory.
